the United States today (Tuesday), according to the country's interior  
ministry. 
Kwon, a South Korean national, was the CEO of Terraform  
Labs, the company behind TerraUSD, a stablecoin that collapsed in May 2022.  
This collapse triggered major volatility in cryptocurrency markets.

the cryptocurrency disaster that saw the loss of nearly $40 billion in a matter  
of days, with the collapse of the TerraUSD and Luna tokens.
